test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 02 Feb 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Substitute the underlined word with its appropriate synonym.**

The crew of the ship was **__attacked__**.
solution: The correct answer is **"assaulted."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Attacked" **means** **to try to hurt or defeat somebody/something by using force. (हमला या आक्रमण करना) • **Example**: *She **attacked**__ her friend.* • **"Assaulted"** means attacked. (अचानक हमला करना, धावा बोलना) __ • **Example**: *She **assaulted**__ her friend.* • The synonym of **"attacked"** is** "assaulted."** • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1, "worshipped"**, means to show reverence or adoration to someone or something. ((की) पूजा करना (परमेश्‍वर या किसी देवता से विनती करना या उसके प्रति सम्‍मान प्रदर्शित करना), आराधना करना) • **Option 2, "synced"**, means to synchronize or coordinate something. (किसी चीज़ को समन्वयित करना) • **Option 3, "saved",** means to rescue or protect someone from harm. (किसी को बचाना, रक्षा करना (मृत्‍यु, क्षति, हानि आदि से)) 181:Tc72, The correct answer is **"championship."**
